decision: Is there enough real demand to justify building the MVP (Phase 3)?
hypothesis: At least 10% of at least 300 eligible unique visitors from Freelance web and UI designers working solo on fixed-price client projects. The designer is the user, payer, and sole decision-maker. First reachable group: des join the research waitlist within 14 days of the page going live.

criteria.label: Eligible unique visitors
criteria.help: Unique non-internal visitor IDs with a landing page view in the window

criteria.label: Visitor-to-waitlist sign-up rate
criteria.help: Unique sign-ups (by email hash) / eligible unique visitors

notes: Exclusions: internal/test traffic (events flagged internal), fixture and bot-flagged events, duplicate emails (counted once by hash), repeat visits (counted once by visitor ID), events before the lock or after the window. Uses the rate-with-floor default (>= 10% with >= 300 visitors) so the denominator is explicit; the alternative (>= 100 sign-ups) is not used. Follow-up answer rate is reported, not gated. A missed visitor floor routes to 2.1 (channels); a missed rate routes to 1.4.
